## Appearance

Stacy is described as having the loveliest fair curly hair. She is also noted for having fascinating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman known for her thoughtful approach to leadership. She demonstrates a careful, tactful, and broadminded nature, guiding others with great skill and understanding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy became the new female schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she quickly provided encouraging guidance to her students. She organized a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag and later assured her class that she would return the following year to guide them through the Queen's entrance preparation. Under her continued mentorship, students like [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepared for and successfully took their [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Muriel Stacy serves as a trusted mentor and encouraging teacher to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After taking over the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, she guides [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through her studies, composition writing, and preparation for the Queen's entrance examinations. Their relationship blossoms into a supportive bond that inspires Anne's academic enthusiasm and personal growth.

- Friend of — trusted mentor and friend to Anne  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>
